annotations.title: Create a rectangle or ellipse primitive

description: Creates a rectangle or ellipse primitive node bound to DS variables. Use for dividers, backgrounds, chart bars/grid-lines/data-points, avatars-as-circles, or any shape with no DS component. Params: shape ("rectangle"|"ellipse", required), parentId (required), name, width, height, fillStyleId/fillVariable/fill, and for rectangle: cornerRadius(Variable), stroke(Variable), strokeWeight, layoutPositioning, layoutSizing*; for ellipse: arcData ({startingAngle, endingAngle, innerRadius} — donut/pie segments). Requires Phase 2. Prefer a DS component over a shape when one exists.

arcData.description: Arc data for donut/pie segments. Ellipse only.

cornerRadius.description: Raw corner radius in pixels. Rectangle only.

cornerRadiusVariable.description: DS variable path for corner radius. Rectangle only.

fill.description: Raw hex color for fill (e.g. "#e4e6ee"). Fallback when no DS styles/variables. Rectangle only.

fillStyleId.description: DS fill style key (from figma_list_ds kind="fill_styles"). Rectangle only.

fillVariable.description: DS variable path for fill color.

layoutPositioning.description: Set to ABSOLUTE to overlay this shape inside an auto-layout parent (e.g., grid lines behind bars). Rectangle only.

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Horizontal sizing mode. Auto-defaults to FIXED when width is specified. Rectangle only.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Vertical sizing mode. Auto-defaults to FIXED when height is specified. Rectangle only.

stroke.description: Raw hex color for stroke. Fallback when no DS stroke variables. Rectangle only.

strokeVariable.description: DS variable path for stroke color. Rectangle only.

strokeWeight.description: Stroke weight in pixels. Rectangle only.

name: figma_create_shape
